title: On PostgreSQL every webhook delivery is dropped at enqueue — "[webhook-auto-enqueuer] enqueue failed … Converting circular structure to JSON (Timeout)" — and the loss is logged at WARN
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect with a named location and a reproduction (silent delivery loss on a supported driver).

- Category: ① — reach: the public data door (`PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID`) with the showcase's declared webhook switched on through `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/showcase_task_changed`, measured on a fresh PostgreSQL 16 database at 307ce4c4 (and again on an 18.0.0-next.5 database the ceremony upgraded).
- Who acts: the seat that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks` / `packages/services/service-messaging` (webhook outbox). Location: `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.ts` (the fire-and-forget `this.enqueue({... payload ...})`, ~line 1167) → `MessagingService.enqueueHttp` → `packages/services/service-messaging/src/sql-http-outbox.ts` ~192 `payload_json: JSON.stringify(input.payload ?? null)`.
- Dedup: local scan of the 1,237 newest issues (state=all, open and closed) for `circular|auto-enqueuer|enqueue failed` — 0 hits; `webhook.*postgres|postgres.*webhook` — 0 hits.

reach: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` on `os dev -d postgres://…` at 307ce4c4, twice (fresh database; upgraded database).
Path: integration-system.webhook-lifecycle
QA-source: #24838 · integration-system.webhook-lifecycle · observed beside the clauses (off-clause probe: driver differences)
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug

## Reproduction (framework 307ce4c4, PostgreSQL 16.15 local)

1. `createdb qa4_fresh`; from `examples/app-showcase`: `os dev --seed-admin -p PORT -d postgres://USER:PASS@127.0.0.1:5432/qa4_fresh`.
2. Sign in as admin@objectos.ai / admin123. `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/showcase_task_changed` body `{"enabled": true}` → 200 `{"success":true,"data":{"type":"webhook","name":"showcase_task_changed","enabled":true}}`.
3. `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` body `{"title":"webhook probe"}` → 200.
4. After 4 s, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_http_delivery`:
   - Expected: one delivery row, `ref_id` `declared:showcase_task_changed` (what the same steps give on SQLite: measured three times this run).
   - Actual: 0 rows. The server log has exactly one line for the event: `WARN [webhook-auto-enqueuer] enqueue failed {"webhook":"showcase_task_changed","eventId":"showcase_task:ID:updated:…","err":"Converting circular structure to JSON\n --> starting at object with constructor 'Timeout'\n | property '_idlePrev' -> object with constructor 'TimersList'\n --- property '_idleNext' closes the circle"}`.
5. Same result on an 18.0.0-next.5 PostgreSQL database after `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` (ceremony complete, marker verified): the PATCH answers 200, no delivery row, the same WARN.

## What is wrong

- Something in the enqueued `payload` carries a Node `Timeout` (a timer handle) on the PostgreSQL path, so `JSON.stringify` throws and the delivery row is never written. SQLite boots of the same app enqueue normally.
- The write that claims to persist the delivery does not land, and the system keeps looking healthy: the record write answered 200, Setup shows the webhook active, and the only trace is a WARN. Under AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels", a dropped durable write is an `error`, said once, with the consequence and the fix.

Not checked in this run: an admin-authored `sys_webhook` row on PostgreSQL (the probe's create was refused for its own body shape), and MySQL.
